# Contrivent

> AI systems that run your busywork. Contrivent finds what matters in a business (Scout), builds AI systems around it (Forge), and operates them in production (Orchestrate). One team, from first signal to running system.

Site: https://contrivent.com
Contact: hello@contrivent.com

## How the work runs

- Scout - Discovery. Map every source a business already runs on, read documents, data, and conversations, and surface only the signals worth building around.
- Forge - Build. Turn each signal into a design with one clear job: architecture, data pipelines, agents and models, assembled into one system and evaluated against real work.
- Orchestrate - Operate. Deploy inside the tools the team already uses. Agents pass work to each other and to people, watch their own results, and improve weekly.
